rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name and zip to locate a single account, then used read-only tools to review the user’s details and most recent order. It correctly stated that a cross-category exchange (bookshelf to camera) is not permitted and offered the compliant alternative of initiating a return once the order is deliverable. The agent did not perform any order-changing writes and asked for confirmation/preferences before any potential changes. It provided order item details supported by tool outputs and indicated that returns/exchanges would need to wait until delivery, which aligns with typical product rules and the policy’s requirement to follow status-based eligibility. While the agent promised a reminder without showing a tool action, no policy breach or unsupported account change occurred. Overall, actions and guidance were compliant, and the interaction concluded satisfactorily given policy constraints.
